entities.name: 5GS update type
entities.description: Information element included during registration procedure to indicate UE requests or capability changes.

entities.name: Registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed by UE to register with the 5G network.

entities.name: SMS over NAS requirement change
entities.description: Condition where UE requests use of SMS over NAS or has changed requirements for SMS over NAS.

entities.name: Radio capability change for NG-RAN
entities.description: Condition where UE's radio capability for NG-RAN has changed.

entities.name: CIoT 5GS optimization request
entities.description: Condition where UE requests CIoT 5GS optimizations.

relations.description: Registration procedure includes the 5GS update type information element.
5GS update type indicates SMS over NAS requirement changes.
5GS update type indicates radio capability changes for NG-RAN.
5GS update type indicates CIoT 5GS optimization requests.
